notes.notes:
The Creation of Planets have been completed and some bugs squatted from the app. I announce this as an official release of what I had planned to do with Shadowforge 14.0, a major milestone in the next chapter unfolded.

Maybe we'll meet again with new updates, on Creation, Image or even File handling.

See you!

notes.title: Shadowforge Patch 13.7
notes.notes:
Added in paint fill tolerance in the button "W" settings.
Fixed FPS in some places (which was the cause of crash errors).
More previewable features.

For the paint fill to not freeze some times, you'll need a super fast computer from the future. There is no solution yet for plusing a stack in this engine by 1 pixel on large canvases.

notes.title: Bug fix, QoL
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug that crashed the app when tiling sprites.

Made Invert Shader useable with lasso areas.

notes.title: Happy Halloween - Major Patch 12.0 is now LIVE!
notes.notes:
NEW MAIN FEATURE

Destiny Tiling (Texture Randomisation Tiling) is something that is great for making authentic work on clothing such as jeans, dresses, shirts, pants and even
mouse pads, covers or go wild and put it behind you on the green screen! Anything is possible with textures. We love textures and always have, it enriches
our minds with eye candy and a sensation of mysteries and thousands of other different emotive affections. It's style, and we love it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36815287/1c5782c01c6a195b1bb4379affe5df4d7f37c22e.png

UPGRADED FEATURE

Spray like never before in Shadowforge. Now you can spray directly by pressing on the mouse button instead of only selecting it on the right menu
bar and pressing enter, possibly dividing the spray with a number value. The method of pressing the mouse button, which I introduce as Spray 2.0 for
the app, follows an invisible red thread. As if it has it's own destiny and on it grows new seeds, which in this case is a custom or themed sprite.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36815287/747504f05d0b1593f9030dceb3578d1fec3ecdbc.png

REPLACED FEATURE ON THE QUICK BAR WITH A CONSISTENT AND BETTER FEATURE

Say good bye to tick tock color value changing and say hello to SCATTER. The SCATTER is divided to Spray 2.0 and Destiny Tiling, but is
a strong foundation pillar.


NEW SUB FEATURE

Meet Scatter Tiling. A sub feature of a foundation feature. It allows you to pick -- with the brush space value input option -- amount of cloned scattered tiles.
Jointed with the Tile Paint Fill, it might be your deal changer for this update.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36815287/2f6b768c49daf8361edad390283c3042cbc3b0d5.png

WIDENED USE FOR "W OPTIONS"

Now compatible with Spray 2.0 and Texture Randomisation Tiling (but from now on I am going to call it Destiny Tile, because why not, I am 100%
independant and work on this by myself so I can name it what I want. Hehe. But I do take any feedback postively and serious. Anyway, moving on to
the next work that has been scheduled and pushed on...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36815287/2559e55eb8bf2f231e8ba17d59cdb0cee5ac35b0.png


BUGS SQUASHED
Fixed crash that occured when using the gif upload icon and after that exiting the game.
Now the display is corrected when the preview when you hover on the text for Barrel and Fish distortion is active.


QOL HEALING
The mouse cursor no longer connects with the top camera slider like it used to due to other things taking up Place.

Below image is a character from Bluetail. Having only washed the lightest white into transparency, I decided to try and make a character that was only a quick concept into a portrait painting resembling some kind of oil painting from the 1600's. Keeping the bone structures that were outlined that make this character a personalised design from someone, yet changed into a shaded version with a few textures.

If you are a seasoned Shadowforge painting veteran, you will be right at home in how to do something like this when starting Shadowforge 12.0.

If you're new, read the guide, or TL;DR, ALT + B into CTRL + B into the Red Sphere icon on the Left Quick Bar. Wash a color into transparency with the black and white eraser icon on the Quick Bar.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36815287/b951b156c9087508a9166034893b8e259b14be94.png

notes.title: Upcoming features and more... for Major Update 12.0.
notes.notes:
Spray Brush 2.0 will be introduced.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36815287/199823ad56a1117dd0efd61577e3912335c8e34c.png

A completely new feature will be sewn together into this simple but beastly engine for you to make awesome textures with. It goes by the name Tiling Randomness but the usage of it is very simple... Texture tiles into extremely pretty images, while still making it look and be authentic.

These updates will be supported with everything in the app, including CTRL + W options. 

Enjoy!

Images below was single-handedly used with only Tiling Randomness, the new feature coming to Shadowforge.

notes.title: Shadowforge Patch 11.3
notes.notes:
Introduced Rectangle Borders with holding down ALT + G then pressing the RMB. To choose a position on the canvas, use ALT + X that is always used as a rectangle marquee, then exit it and hold down ALT + G. The position is locked on to that position.

The frame skipping while lassoing has been capped at 0, which means that it is removed. You can now draw or lasso beautiful silohouettes.

notes.title: Patch 8.7.3
notes.notes:
Greetings!

The middle mouse button should now correctly move the canvas around the window without any painful hurdles.
However, if you are working on an over 3000x3000 canvas, you might want to zoom out or use the camera sliders.

The Gray Shader now shades everything gray, not just anything at or below 253 value.

notes.notes:
I added in so that if you mouse over "Rotate Sprite" it will remove the string you wrote and start at image angle 0.

When the animation player is up and you mouse over the text where you can write numbers to, they are now highlighted in green.

Just updated Shadowforge that fixes a couple of bugs. The rectangle marquee and draw tiled tools.

Made lasso edit mode be able to move rotated and/or scaled parts without it resetting the part to it's real shape.

notes.title: Patch 8.2.0

Now when recording yourself drawing on the canvas, it will choose the first layer as the movie roll. Please use what background you want on that layer so that the background won't be completly black in your gif file.

See you in the shadows.

notes.title: Patch 8.1.5

It's possible to use the mouse in the start room now. When you get to the config room, you can choose if you want to back up your project or not.

New feature added which will save a back up of your project when and if you exit the program without getting the chance to save your project. It's under the "Files" menu and it is called "Restore Project".

QoL patch that removes the RGB sliders (because we don't need them) and when pressing/clicking to flip or mirror your canvas, you only do it once, and not twice.

notes.title: Patch 7.4.0 Color Tinting
notes.notes: Added in color tinting. Red, Green and Blue sliders to make your painting more or less of that color.

notes.title: Patch 7.3.2
notes.notes:
Well met!

The rectangle marquee. You need to press ALT + X to call it in, and then hold right mouse button on the canvas, before releasing it, press Left Mouse Button to put it on your brush and on the docker. Warp it with ALT + W.

Scrollable animation frames on the docker instead of "sets".

Move the animation frames on the docker (accessed by pressing CTRL + E) with the middle mouse button where you want them. Left click on one frame and then middle mouse button on another frame.

Made every layer have it's own undo and redo. You will no longer see something you've drawn from layer 2 be on layer 1 when you undo or redo.

I've changed the undo/redo to undo or redo about every 1 second when you hold down the undo or redo button. Also added in debugging text for it, and I managed to find a bug in the undo/redo system. That is now fixed.

Now all the palettes, sliders and the mini canvas can be moved.

To move the palettes and the sliders, CTRL + Hold Left Mouse Button on them.

To move the mini canvas just SHIFT + Hold Right Mouse Button on it. To make it disappear, right mouse button + left mouse button. To make it appear again, right mouse button. To make the size bigger or smaller, press on minus or plus on the keyboard.

Added in Auto Brush and Manual Brush. They can be used on the second misc menu.

Auto Brush makes your brush decrease in size automatically while drawing, then when releasing the mouse button it turns back to it's original brush size (which you have picked from the horizontal and vertical slider).

Manual Brush is the default way of drawing. It's what you start with when you enter DigiPaint.

And more undocumented changes.

notes.title: Permanent brushes update
notes.notes: Your permanent brushes in the "Click here for brushes" menu are now displaying their image in a 50x50 scale. But you can also name them with CTRL + Left Mouse Button.

notes.title: Shadowforge 5.3.1 (animation update)
notes.notes: This quality of life update makes it so that when the left mouse button is clicked on an animation frame, it will select it without placing it on the canvas. Placing it on the canvas is only performed by right mouse clicking the animation frame.

notes.title: Keeping the opacity update
notes.notes: When you press ALT + E after you have lassoed, the lassoed part won't lose the opacity that it had.

notes.title: Animation update
notes.notes:
I changed how variables work when adding a frame so that there will no longer be duplicates added from that frame to the next frames.

The counter variable is one single thread, and not individually different. There is only one variable entity that controls the counter for when it's time to move on to the next order.

It's hard to explain if you are not a programmer but all you need to know is that the dupe bug is fixed according to my tests.

notes.title: Crucial bug fix to outline shader
notes.notes: Fixed a bug that made the outline color inside the outline. It now only colors the outline. This happened in conjunction with using a specific drawing tool. But it's now fixed. I know the outline shader seems really popular amongst youtubers, sticker makers, and possibly more. I'm happy to have it fixed, sorry that it took awhile. I knew about this when I streamed on twitch a few days ago but I was painting until I found more bugs.

notes.title: Previewing shaders performance update
notes.notes: Added a slight delay to showing a preview of the shader when hovering over that shader icon. The delay is barely noticeable and boosts performance.

notes.title: Onionskin update
notes.notes: Reverted the onion skinning back to what it was. Which means, you will always draw above going up each layer.

notes.title: Documentation update
notes.notes: Some things added to documentation and some things changed. Only on Steam since I will probably not continue to subscribe for another year on the official site.

notes.title: Merging layers update
notes.notes: You can now merge layers from one layer page to another layer page. Right click on "Right click here to reset layers merging" to not merge the layer you picked to merge anymore.

notes.title: QoL update
notes.notes:
Now on the docker's animation row a text is displayed showing each of your animation frames size. Furthermore, when you choose your canvas size it will resize all 100 layers.

Restart on the right menu will destroy your linked layers that you have copied (they are shadowed on the layer menu). If you want to keep one of the linked layers, then merge it with another layer by pressing on the middle mouse button.

notes.title: Custom built-in palette update
notes.notes:
Fixed so that you can draw when the first thing you do is pick a custom palette and draw.
Made it work with the Draw Tiled feature.

notes.title: A bug fix
notes.notes: Fixed a bug not being able to change horizontal and vertical size when a brush is picked.

notes.title: Onionskin update
notes.notes: You now need to move the layer with right mouse button to copy it to a new layer (with onionskin on).

notes.title: I "was wrong" about the GMS update, giving out the "ingredient" for SF tools
notes.notes:
So I have to study about nine slice functions and I may be wrong about how they are actually intended to be used. As a compensation for me being potentially wrong about it, I am handing you the gradient sprite for you to use in Shadowforge.

https://i.imgur.com/fFEsemO.png

notes.title: Bug fix
notes.notes: Fixed a bug that made you draw on your canvas when you used the camera sliders.

notes.title: QoL update
notes.notes: When you press CTRL + G you also hide/reveal the layer name sign.

notes.title: Bug fix time
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug that made you draw when you click the second time on the canvas.
Fixed a crash when you CTRL + M when you start the software when there was nothing to merge.

notes.title: Flipped palettes and eye dropping colors update
notes.notes:
I flipped the palettes to make it work with the latest eye drop update.

This eye drop update is a lot more user friendly. It lets you eye drop without hiding the palettes.

notes.title: Rotation Update
notes.notes:
Added in Rotation Brush Slider and Rotation Brush. The RBS lets you pick your brush angle, while the Rotation Brush (Icon) does the rotation for you while you draw.

Some bug fixes here and there. One important thing was that lassoing while outside of the canvas would crash the software (if you're unlucky). That is fixed now.

notes.title: Perspective tool update
notes.notes:
Made when using the sliders, the PT will not vanish.
Changed the PT to be GUI interactable, instead of interacted with the canvas.
Put in text and different colors for the edges on the PT.
Made the performance faster with the PT.

notes.title: Lasso tool update #2
notes.notes: When you right click with lasso tool mode on, you can save the lassoed painting to your docker.

notes.title: Animation update and icons update
notes.notes:
The animation window can get bigger if you right click on it, if you right click on it again it gets back to it's original size.
The docker does not duplicate the animation frames anymore.
When you click on the animation frame on the docker, you'll wipe the drawing you drew and it will get replaced with the drawing on the animation docker.

Some icons have been moved to other places.

notes.title: Layer menu update #3
notes.notes: Made all layers interactable with all onionskins when clicking on respective layer. This code has been utilized with the left and right arrow keys since a long time ago.

notes.title: Windowed mode bug fix
notes.notes: Shadowforge does now not start in full screen because of a bug with the windowed mode if it starts in full screen.

notes.title: Layer menu update #1
notes.notes: Left mouse button pressing on a layer on the menu will take you to that layer.

notes.title: Rotating canvas and drawing bug fix
notes.notes: Fixed a bug that made you draw duplicates in different directions while rotating the canvas.

notes.title: Renaming layers and onionskin update
notes.notes: You can now rename your layers. The onionskins has been increased in quantity to reflect how many layers you can rename.

notes.title: New UI graphics, QoL improvements and paint fill update
notes.notes:
SF now has a clean graphical UI. Improvements were made to how you interact outside of the Palette and Scale UI when you have pressed on it.

Paint fill is back to what it was, but it makes four grids now instead of one grid. However, painting fast with the paint fill tool on will make you lose some of the grids. I have made the grids represent itself visually while drawing with paint fill mode.

notes.title: Raycasting with fill tool experiment and nature shader update
notes.notes:
When I mean raycasting, I mean a method that locks down different parts to be flooded when they have been flooded. It's very early in development and may be thrown in the bin or developed on further.

Other news, I have removed the pixelation effect from Nature Shader and given it that gothic dark nature look. I recommend Warm Shader for nature things too, since it's very moody.

notes.title: Paint fill tool update and how I want it to work
notes.notes:
I patched in a paint fill tool that is working with however fast you are moving with your mouse or pen. You can also see how I want it to work by pressing CTRL + F and drawing with it. But it's not working like I want it to.

However, in big resolutions, it might not be that very much noticeable.

notes.title: Polygon tool update (not the mask one)
notes.notes: Pressing CTRL + 5 will quickly make your polygons into a triangle. This is appropriate when you want to start making a new polygon tree. For example, you might have made a polygon human hand and after you're done with it and pressed CTRL + T to print it to the surface, then you want to start over to make the arm.

notes.title: Polygon tool brush update
notes.notes: Polygon tool brush is now a brush and a mask simultaneously. You can mask your drawings with Polygon Tool Brush & Mask.

notes.title: Paint fill update and a hotfix
notes.notes:
Switching horizontally or vertically your sprite with CTRL + H or CTRL + V now draws until you switch, and not only one time.

Paint filling works with rotating the cam and flipping or mirroring the sprite. I suggest that you use the square brush for paint filling.

notes.title: New patch reduces lag for bigger canvases
notes.notes: I have reduced the amount of lag you get on very big canvases, resulting in the removal of saving back-ups on the docker. Undo is still there, the backend code has just changed to something that is not as laggy in the software client.

notes.title: Gameboy Shader Update
notes.notes: I know that gameboy artists like to add a light tint on their art so I made it work with the gameboy shader. Feedback is welcomed, like if there should be white color too or to leave it out and anything else you have in mind.

notes.title: Paint fill update
notes.notes: Paint filling works with scaling your sprite.

notes.title: Eye drop tool + a hotfix
notes.notes:
You can now eyedrop colors with CTRL + P. The sliders need to be hidden before you do that.
Draw Horizontally and Vertically can be used again.

notes.title: Hotfix Resize to Sprite Size
notes.notes: Resize to Sprite Size works again.

notes.title: Font hotfix
notes.notes: Using a custom font will no longer change the font on some UI text. Now you can be in text mode as long as you want, if you don't want to be in text mode anymore, press CTRL + Q.

notes.title: Polygonal tool update
notes.notes: With the help of the GM community, I updated the polygonals to move together to the mouse pointer.

notes.title: Update on the pixel lasso
notes.notes: I had to make the pixel lasso bigger the bigger canvas you have. Grids are CPU heavy, and making a grid cover more than 256x256 on a canvas with a pixel size of 2x2 is going to make the app hang up. Unless there are other ways to do this in GMS2.3+, this will have to do for now.

notes.title: Shadowforge Stable Version 2.1
notes.notes: I fixed the last bug which was that the canvas saved itself to the docker when pressing on the UI. I believe Shadowforge is now bug free. Correct me if I'm wrong. No worries. Just send a mail to support.

notes.title: Copying the sprite mask update and 50% off supporter pack!
notes.notes: If you press the home icon and then right mouse click on anything on the canvas, it will finally measure the size of the sprite that you are using. Which means, that you can use any sprite to copy with to the brush docker.

notes.title: Bugfix for fast brush
notes.notes: Fast brush can be used on a canvas bigger than 1920x1080 now. It doesn't switch to slow brush when scaling the sprite either.

notes.title: More Simplified Chinese translations and a bugfix
notes.notes:
Chinese userbase and support is growing. Translation to the left UI for chinese users is done.
Multiply alpha bug fixed that only allowed you to multiply alpha once.

notes.title: Erase bug fix
notes.notes: Erase now does not draw slow when it's not supposed to.

notes.title: Layers update
notes.notes: You can now choose if you want to draw above or below the layer. For animations, click on the animation strip icon.

notes.title: Reverted the patch
notes.notes: Due to bugs, I have reverted it to what it was in September 27th.

notes.notes:
The painting room`s UI for supporters now look like this and is renamed to Bronze Dragon Neon Theme.

notes.title: Tracer update
notes.notes:
You can now mouse button right click to make the tracer appear on the marked spot you have chosen, making it a lot easier to trace sprites to another sprite.

The button for Tracer has changed to the virtual key ALT to make it changeable while the mouse is on the canvas and to make it work.

notes.title: Shader bug fix
notes.notes: Add Clear Assets now return the assets how they were like, and not squared.

notes.title: Saving/loading a project update
notes.notes: Saving and loading a project did not work with updates so I changed it so that you now need to add a frame on the docker and then save what's on the docker. You can then load up what you've recently been drawing.

notes.title: Shadowforge´s Major Update After Release
notes.notes:
* Fixed graphical glitches that appeared when you vector drew.
* Made the sprite preview fit the vector size.
* Added calculations to the vector.
* When you press 'delete' with the vector icon greenlighted, you can shade it.

* The vector matrixes (or fake 3d vector) is now below the sprite drawing. Which means you can now draw on the vector matrixes.

* Shading now works when you save the image.

* Now all colors show on the "E" docker.
* When you restart the canvas, your new sprites will be undoable and redoable if you add a background. It's really important that you remove your brush before restarting the canvas.

* Shadows and alpha up/down buttons now work correctly.

* Uploading an image is back. The upload image file icon can now be interacted with. The issues with certain colors disappearing when uploading an image is fixed.

* White Background renamed to Color Background.
* Color Background, when pressed enter on, creates a background with the color picked.
* Undo/redo added for color background.
You can now color your background on the depth you created it with the buffer paint tool.

* Moving/copying all sprites will no longer overwrite your last used brush.

* I had to rewrite the save/load project code because I've switched from GMS2.2 to GMS2.3.

* Changed the speed for when you resize your brush.

* "E" docker is back and more cleaner.
* Buttons: Green when pressed on, orange when used, red when not used.
* Colors corrected for stamp and draw horizontally/vertically.
* Max zoom out increased to 0.10. Max canvas size capped at 7999x7999.
* Button "O", which was draw symmetrically, and would not be saved on the image file has been replaced with a brush tracer that creates lines that follow the location you last drew on. Button "T" has been removed.

* You can now stamp, draw tiled horizontally/vertically with the color you picked. Max zoom out has been increased.

* The shading tool is now slightly visible on your cursor.

* Save colors on a palette board. You must hide the palette with the "G" button if you want to use the palette board.
* "G" button is now 100% responsive.

* Made the draw mode default when switching layers.
* Fixed the size of the eraser to be as big as the sprite.
* Added in Fast Brush / Slow Brush toggle. Toggling between Fast Brush and Slow Brush is done by pressing the "B" button and then pressing "B" button again to return to Fast Brush.

* Fixed a bug where sprite numbers were increasing when picking a scale for your sprite.
* Made a tooltip appear when you hover your mouse over Scale Up and Scale Down.
* Fixed issues that made scaling really slow.
* Fixed a bug that made the brush scale really fast the longer you have drawn.
* Removed the ability to scale everything on the canvas when you have the ability to rotate the camera (and copy & move your drawing).

* Fixed Erase mode display message.
* You don't need to draw first to scale your brush.

notes.title: Situation on the layering drawing update
notes.notes:
I think I have fixed the problem where you couldn't draw and the room had to reset. If you want to draw in this software, I made it so that if you draw 30 000 sprites on one depth, then the depth continues to go up and then resets to 0 at -1000.

This means the depth layering won't act as canvas layers. I'm not sure when and if I will add canvas layers to Shadowforge. But I'm pretty happy now with this system.

I might make the layers move up somehow in the future if it works so that you won't draw below your drawing when it resets to 0.

Update: It seems to work without moving the layers up. Meaning, when it resets to 0, you can draw above your drawing anyhow.

notes.title: Bug fixes, steam workshop, new button
notes.notes:
So I've been fixing a few bugs, I haven't noted down everything I've fixed since bugs are a nuisance and once they're gone, I don't think of them anymore. But I fixed one major bug which was that you could not scale down your image if it's smaller than it's original size. It has been fixed and what I am about to tell you now has nothing to do with a barrier or something I've put on it to get it fixed. 

If you upload an image, it will start with a smaller size than it originally is. However, if you scale it up, it will not lose it's original nice looking textures.

I'm working on fixing the steam workshop. I've seen a lot people trying to upload their brushes. I've now made the images to be stored in the directory path minus directory "Brushes".

A new button has appeared in the software. It's a button you click on to choose if you want to choose all your drawn sprites or just a single one. With it, you can for example scale all individually at once, or just one single image if you switch back to a single drawn sprite.

One interesting feature with that button is that when you pick the "interact with all sprites" button and you choose "Move" on the menu, you can zoom in or out and take a picture of your canvas, it will then be put on your brush, essentially copying the camera border and drawing with it. However, I suggest that only high tech computers should use this method. It needs to load, but if you're fine with it loading for a while, then that's fine too. But I have not tested it on lower specs.

notes.title: Here's a few tips for the new patch
notes.notes:
If you want the sprite to be visible on your cursor, so that you can get a preview of where you are putting/drawing it on then you must pick a scale for your sprite.

Remember to press on Add Clear Assets if you don't want to scale the previous stamped sprite too.

I've been working all day to make this sprite preview work, and it seems to me that it is working now without any errors.

notes.notes:

For Pro users:
Press G to record the animation, and when it ends, press G again to save it on file.
